# simple parse reuse from earlier quickly
def parse_tree(text):
    text=text.strip()
    if text.endswith(';'): text=text[:-1]
    def node(s,i):
        while i<len(s) and s[i] in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
        if s[i]=='(':
            i+=1; children=[]
            while True:
                c,i=node(s,i); children.append(c)
                while i<len(s) and s[i] in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
                if i<len(s) and s[i]==',': i+=1; continue
                if i<len(s) and s[i]==')': i+=1; break
                raise ValueError((s[i:i+20],i))
            st=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ':,' and s[i] not in '()' and s[i] not in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
            name=s[st:i]
            while i<len(s) and s[i] in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
            length=None
            if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
                i+=1; st=i
                while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',()' and s[i] not in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
                length=float(s[st:i]) if s[st:i] else None
            return (name,length,children),i
        else:
            st=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ':,' and s[i] not in '()' and s[i] not in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
            name=s[st:i]
            while i<len(s) and s[i] in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
            length=None
            if i<len(s) and s[i]==':':
                i+=1; st=i
                while i<len(s) and s[i] not in ',()' and s[i] not in ' \\t\\r\\n': i+=1
                length=float(s[st:i]) if s[st:i] else None
            return (name,length,[]),i
    r,i=node(text,0); return r

def metrics(path):
    root=parse_tree(open(path).read())
    total=0; internal=0; nleaves=0; ninternal=0
    stack=[root]
    while stack:
        name,length,children=stack.pop()
        if length is not None:
            total+=length
            if children:
                internal+=length
        if children:
            ninternal+=1; stack.extend(children)
        else:
            nleaves+=1
    return nleaves, total, internal, (internal/total if total else None)

for label,p in [('animals','tmp/scogs_animals/*.treefile'),('fungi','tmp/scogs_fungi/*.treefile')]:
